name: Catholic Mexican Girl
summary: The Catholic Mexican Girl aesthetic, also known as Latina Fairy , is a fashion microtrend that originated in 2023 on TikTok.
description:
The Catholic Mexican Girl aesthetic, also known as Latina Fairy , is a fashion microtrend that originated in 2023 on TikTok. [ 1 ] It blends the hyper-feminine elements of the Coquette aesthetic with a romanticized interpretation of traditional Mexican and Spanish colonial imagery. The trend is characterized by the use of religious iconography as fashion accessories, distinct hair braiding styles, and attire that references the "Old World" colonial era of the Americas, specifically the region historically known as New Spain. [ 2 ]

The aesthetic gained popularity following high-fashion collections that utilized similar motifs, notably the Mirror Palais Collection III, which featured dresses inspired by Spanish colonial silhouettes, and the Dior Cruise 2024 collection, which drew heavy inspiration from Frida Kahlo and Oaxacan textiles. On social media, the trend involves users (often Latinas or those emulating the look) posing in solemn, quasi-religious settings such as cathedrals, candlelit altars, or colonial plazas.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Romanticization of religious tradition, hyper-femininity, "Old World" nostalgia
